A claimer's deposits and withdrawals count from their first claim in the period until {n} days after their last claim. “W/L after promo” = their deposits − withdrawals − bonus given. Suggestion: Cancel if that is negative, Adjust if the bonus is over {p}% of their deposits, otherwise Keep. Change these in Settings.
领取者的充值和提款，从期间内第一次领取算起，到最后一次领取后 {n} 天为止。“扣优惠后输赢”= 他们的充值 − 提款 − 赠送金额。建议：结果为负数是“取消”，赠送超过他们充值的 {p}% 是“调整”，其余为“保留”。可在系统设置里修改。

Deposit dan penarikan pengklaim dihitung dari klaim pertama dalam periode sampai {n} hari setelah klaim terakhir. “M/K setelah promo” = deposit − penarikan − bonus. Saran: Batalkan jika hasilnya negatif, Sesuaikan jika bonus lebih dari {p}% deposit mereka, selain itu Pertahankan. Ubah di Pengaturan.
A claimer's deposits and withdrawals count towards a promotion from their first claim until this many days after their last claim.
领取者的充值和提款，从第一次领取算起，到最后一次领取后这么多天为止，都算进这个优惠。
Deposit dan penarikan pengklaim dihitung untuk promosi sejak klaim pertama sampai sekian hari setelah klaim terakhir.
A contacted player counts as returned if they make a deposit within {n} days after the contact (Settings → Churn & CS). Deposits shown are what they deposited in that window.
被联系的玩家在联系后 {n} 天内充值，就算回流（系统设置 → 流失与客服）。显示的充值是这段时间内的金额。
Pemain yang dihubungi dihitung kembali jika deposit dalam {n} hari setelah kontak (Pengaturan → Churn & CS). Deposit yang ditampilkan adalah deposit dalam jangka waktu itu.
A contacted player who deposits within this many days counts as returned for that CS.
被联系的玩家在这么多天内充值，就算这位客服拉回的。
Pemain yang dihubungi dan deposit dalam sekian hari dihitung kembali untuk CS tersebut.
A later period is already settled and may depend on this one (carried losses). Delete the later one first.
之后的期间已经结算，可能用到了这次的结转亏损。请先删除之后的结算。
Periode berikutnya sudah di-settle dan mungkin bergantung pada ini (kerugian dibawa). Hapus yang berikutnya dulu.
A losing period is taken off the next profitable one before anything is paid out.
亏损的期间会先从下一个盈利期间扣除，扣完才分红。
Periode rugi dipotong dari periode untung berikutnya sebelum ada pembagian.
A player is listed once their last deposit is older than the thresholds in Settings → Churn & CS ({days} days). When they deposit again they drop off the list automatically.
玩家最后一次充值超过系统设置 → 流失与客服里的天数（{days} 天）就会列出。再次充值后会自动从名单移除。
Pemain masuk daftar jika deposit terakhirnya lebih lama dari batas di Pengaturan → Churn & CS ({days} hari). Jika deposit lagi, otomatis keluar dari daftar.

Back office = the deposits and withdrawals entered or imported. Statement = the daily PG/bank figures entered under Data entry → PG & bank statements. Differences up to {tol} are treated as matched (Settings → Promotions & reconciliation).
后台 = 录入或导入的充值和提款。流水 = 在数据录入 → PG 与银行流水里录入的每日 PG/银行数字。差额在 {tol} 以内算对上（系统设置 → 优惠与对账）。

Back office = deposit dan penarikan yang diinput atau diimpor. Laporan = angka harian PG/bank yang diinput di Input data → Laporan PG & bank. Selisih sampai {tol} dianggap cocok (Pengaturan → Promosi & rekonsiliasi).
